opening.argument: The footage presents Stray as a game about a cat navigating a mysterious city, using its skills to solve puzzles and interacting with an inhabitant. The speaker introduces the game and announces its release window and platforms. Those details serve to show viewers what the game is and when and where it will be available. The city, characters, and challenges are presented as gameplay, not as real-world events or promises of a financial outcome. Taken together, the footage and narration are consistent with a promotional entertainment trailer.

citations.quote: In Stray, you play as a cat who has fallen inside the mysterious and forgotten city.
players must navigate their way through the dangers. Of this unfriendly place, and use the cat's skills to solve puzzles and uncover mysteries.
Stray is coming to PS4, PS5 as well as PC in early 2022
